strike_3.name: Strike
description: A basic physical attack with a weapon,
that deals damage to a single target.

stagger.name: Stagger
description: A hand-to-hand attack with a weapon, that deals damage to a single target.
When successful, Stagger moves the target to the bottom of the turn order.
Each successful Stagger reduces the chance of the next Stagger by half.

double_throw.name: Double Throw
description: A ranged attack with a thrown weapon, that deals damage to a single target.
Double Throw attacks twice, but both attacks have a lower chance to hit.
